description: [alias of cuba_juez] LLM-judge for semantically-conflicting observations in the ambiguous cosine-similarity band (0.6-0.8), where heuristics miss vocabulary-different conflicts. Verdicts are cached in brain_judgments.

action.description: judge_pair: decide on two given observation ids. scan_entity: pull ambiguous pairs for an entity and judge each.

max_pairs.description: Max pairs to escalate per call (default 5; controls LLM cost)

name: memory_juez
